method: READ-ONLY, in one process, of the HEAD code at the base commit over the live pinned inputs: the box default S3 client wrapped so only get_object, head_object and list_objects_v2 pass; select_business_date; HoldingsPublication.begin and VersionedInputs; build_snapshot once for the 49financial firm; served_publication; then the WITHOUT arm runs evaluate_publish_gate with no evidence provider on a deep copy and the WITH arm runs evaluate_publish_gate with the provider run_firm builds on a second deep copy; lost is the served account ids minus the candidate scope and account-node ids; each lost account is classed once in order; classified_security_lost is now_unclassified & (placed - unplaced). Nothing is landed, written, published, signed or invoked.
notes: Each count rests on one build of the candidate and one read of the served index and Gold parquet, through the repository's own readers.
